test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of ESIC, which is an autonomous body created by the law under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Employees' State Insurance Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) is a statutory and an autonomous body under the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 
 
• The ESI Corporation provides health insurance and medical services to workers enrolled under the Employee State Insurance scheme.
 
• Employee State Insurance scheme is a social Insurance provided by the Employees’ State Insurance Act, 1948. 
 
• ESIC provides the following benefits under the ESI scheme:
 
• Medical Benefit - Full medical care to the insured person and his family members.
 
• Sickness Benefit - Sickness Benefit in the form of cash compensation at the rate of 70 per cent of wages is payable to insured workers during the periods of certified sickness for a maximum of 91 days in a year.
 
• Maternity Benefit - 26 weeks of maternity leave benefit and medical service are provided, which can be extended further.
 
• Disablement Benefit – for Temporary disablement benefit (TDB) and Permanent disablement benefit (PDB)
 
• Dependents Benefit - Paid in the form of monthly payment to the dependents in cases where death is due to employment injury or occupational hazards.
 
• Physical Rehabilitation - In case of physical disablement due to employment injury.
 
• Old Age Medical Care - For Insured Person retiring on attaining the age of superannuation or under VRS.
